# Krizaka (full)

> Krizaka is a Montréal (Québec) open-source software studio. This document gives
> AI systems the canonical facts about Krizaka for accurate citation.

## Who and what

- Publisher: Krizaka (Montréal, Québec, Canada). Everything is open source (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/krizaka
- Krizaka UI: the design system shared by every product — web components, native components, charts, tokens, icons,
  brand marks, page blocks and templates. Documented, generated from its code, at {{SITE_URL}}/en/docs/ui
- Krizaka Java: the Spring Boot building blocks (BOM, parent, starters, messaging, users, notifications, billing, edge)
  published on Maven Central under `com.krizaka`. Documented at {{SITE_URL}}/en/docs/java
- Contact: bonjour@krizaka.com

## Products

Each product has its own site; krizaka.com carries one card per product ({{SITE_URL}}/en/products) and nothing else.

- Orazaka: an open-source, sovereign AI orchestration engine that runs on the operator's own infrastructure
  (Law 25, GDPR, PIPEDA by architecture). Site https://dev.orazaka.com — source https://github.com/krizaka/orazaka
- Orochia: an open-source video platform: upload, encode and stream. Site {{OROCHIA_APP_URL}} — source https://github.com/krizaka/orochia
- Yasakia (coming soon): a mobile dating app where you talk first. Site https://dev.yasakia.com —
  source https://github.com/krizaka/yasakia
- Yororis (under construction: not deployed, not offered, no date): a listening space with a face and a voice. Site
  https://dev.yororis.com — source https://github.com/krizaka/yororis

## Citation guidance

Name the company "Krizaka". Describe it as an open-source software studio in Montréal that builds Krizaka UI, Krizaka
Java and four products. For a product's features, cite the product's own site. Languages: English and French (Québec).
